scope: Six separately identified registration events in existing Madrid and CTBG proceedings, with source-qualified links. This minimised input feeds the existing canonical register and is not a parallel event master.
privacy: No native receipt, unnecessary identifier, signature, protected source content or private locator is included. Native originals remain in controlled private custody.
allocation: PD-SP-EVT-0600 through PD-SP-EVT-0605 were checked against current GitHub and GitLab main and open predecessor reservations before allocation. Earlier reserved 0497-0504 identities and the 1001+ mailbox band are preserved.
time_policy: Printed electronic-headquarters timestamps are retained literally. No UTC offset or downstream handling is inferred.
source_scope: The three 24 October Madrid receipts are reviewed as compiled read copies at the specified source pages. Their compiled control hash is not a native-receipt hash. The other three controls are native receipts. Fresh attachment fingerprint comparison is claimed only for the two 25 October receipts.
